R.label: Results
R.summary: Moves things forward, enjoys a challenge and measures progress by outcomes.

leadership.strength: Gives clear direction and keeps momentum when a goal is in sight.
leadership.limitation: Can push pace harder than the team can sustain.

goal_setting.strength: Sets stretching, concrete targets and owns them.
goal_setting.limitation: May skip agreeing the target with others first.

creativity.strength: Generates bold options when the usual route is blocked.
creativity.limitation: Drops ideas quickly if they do not pay off fast.

delegation.strength: Hands over whole outcomes rather than single tasks.
delegation.limitation: Takes work back when others seem slow.

communication.strength: Direct and to the point; people know where they stand.
communication.limitation: Can sound abrupt; may not check how a message landed.

decision_making.limitation: Can commit before the facts that matter are in.

A.label: Affiliative
A.summary: Energised by people, persuasive and quick to build rapport.

leadership.strength: Creates enthusiasm and a sense of belonging in a group.
leadership.limitation: May avoid hard conversations to keep the mood positive.

goal_setting.strength: Makes goals feel shared and worth chasing.
goal_setting.limitation: Goals can stay inspiring but vague.

creativity.strength: Builds on others' ideas and connects people who should meet.
creativity.limitation: Can chase the newest idea before finishing the last.

delegation.strength: Matches tasks to people's interests and motivates them.

communication.strength: Warm, expressive and good at reading the room.
communication.limitation: May talk through a point when listening would help more.

decision_making.strength: Brings people along so decisions stick.
decision_making.limitation: Can be swayed by the most recent or most liked voice.

P.label: Paced
P.summary: Steady, patient and dependable; values consistency and cooperation.

leadership.strength: Builds trust and a calm, reliable team rhythm.
leadership.limitation: May hold back from stepping forward when a change is needed.

goal_setting.strength: Sets realistic goals and sticks with them over time.

creativity.strength: Improves existing processes patiently and practically.

delegation.strength: Supports others and checks in kindly.
delegation.limitation: May keep work to avoid burdening others.

communication.strength: A good listener who makes others feel heard.
communication.limitation: May not voice disagreement until late.

decision_making.strength: Considers the impact on everyone involved.
decision_making.limitation: Needs time; can delay under pressure to decide fast.

D.label: Detail
D.summary: Careful, analytical and quality-minded; likes to get things right.

leadership.strength: Sets high standards and leads through expertise.
leadership.limitation: Can over-control the details of others' work.

goal_setting.strength: Breaks goals into precise, checkable steps.
goal_setting.limitation: Can plan for longer than needed before starting.

creativity.strength: Finds elegant solutions through deep analysis.
creativity.limitation: May reject ideas that are not yet fully worked out.

delegation.strength: Gives clear specifications and quality criteria.
delegation.limitation: Finds it hard to accept 'good enough'.

communication.limitation: Can come across as reserved or overly technical.

decision_making.strength: Weighs evidence thoroughly and avoids careless errors.
